newsitem.title: USA: Fed says coupon pass totaled $1.117 billion.
newsitem.headline: Fed says coupon pass totaled $1.117 billion.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York said Monday's coupon pass operation totaled $1.117 billion, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The Fed bought coupons from November 15, 2007, to February 15, 2027, for delivery on Tuesday.

The move was in line with the market's expectations. Analysts had said earlier on Monday the Fed was seen adding permanent reserves to the system. The move was perceived to have no monetary policy implications, analysts said.
